outcome: Composite of adverse perinatal outcomes (intrauterine death, Apgar score at 5 min <7, abnormal acid-base status, neonatal intensive care unit admission)
cohort: The study included 646 singleton pregnancies (317 appropriate for gestational age (AGA) and 329 late fetal growth restriction (FGR)) with scans between 36 and 40 weeks, attempting vaginal delivery.
finding: Cerebroplacental ratio (CPR) and umbilicocerebral ratio (UCR) showed poor diagnostic performance in predicting adverse perinatal outcomes in both appropriate for gestational age and late fetal growth restricted fetuses.
birth_weight: Appropriate for gestational age (AGA) fetuses (estimated fetal weight and abdominal circumference >10th and <90th percentile) and late fetal growth restricted (FGR) fetuses (defined by Delphi consensus criteria).
